title: Export Content From the List: Download, Add to Plan, Send

chapters.title: Export Content From the List
chapters.subtitle: Download, add to a plan, or send

steps.text: Moving content to another Orchard Core site can start on the content items list. Three actions there export a content item: download it as JSON, add it to a deployment plan, or send it to a deployment target. Let's enable them and try each one.
Three features add actions to the Actions menu of a content item. View Or Download Content As JSON shows the item as a JSON document, and saves it as a file.
Add Content To Deployment Plan puts a Content Item step in a plan you choose. Each time the plan runs, it exports the item.
Export Content To Deployment Target sends the items you select once, through a target such as File Download. It uses one plan, which you choose in the settings.
The actions appear for users with the Export Data permission. Adding to a plan also needs Manage deployment plans. Administrators have both.
Let's open Tools, Features, and search for content items list. Three features match: View Or Download Content As JSON, Add Content To Deployment Plan, and Export Content To Deployment Target.
Each lists Deployment among its dependencies, and enabling a feature enables its dependencies too. Let's select the three, open Bulk Actions, and choose Enable.
When the page reloads, each of the three rows shows the Enabled badge. The export action also uses a deployment plan, which the settings choose.

chapters.title: View or download as JSON
chapters.subtitle: One content item, saved as a file

steps.text: On the content items list, let's open the Actions menu of Apple Harvest Schedule. After a divider, below Unpublish, Delete and Clone, come View as JSON and Download as JSON.
View as JSON opens the item in a text editor, under the title View As JSON Article. The editor shows the content item with all its parts and fields.
Download saves the document as a file named after the item's identifier. Cancel returns to the list.
On the list, Download as JSON saves the same document directly, and the menu closes. Both options export the published version of the item.
Let's add Apple Harvest Schedule to a plan. Open its Actions menu and choose Add to Deployment Plan.
The Available Deployment Plans dialog has a card for every plan on the site. Let's select Orchard Harvest Content.
The list reloads with a notification: Content added successfully to the deployment plan.
Let's open Tools, Deployments, Plans, and choose Manage Steps for Orchard Harvest Content.
The plan has a Content Item step that shows the title of the article. The step stores only the item's identifier, so each run exports the published version at that moment.
To add several items, select their checkboxes. When two or more are selected, an Actions menu appears above the list. Choose Add to deployment plan.
A confirmation dialog asks about the bulk action. Select Ok, then select the plan in the dialog that follows.
The same notification appears. Let's open the plan again with Manage Steps: each selected item has its own Content Item step.
Enabling the export feature creates a plan for it. Let's open Tools, Deployments, Plans, and choose Manage Steps for Export content to deployment plan target.
Its only step is Export Content To Deployment Target. It stands for the items you select in the content items list.
Then open Settings, Deployment Targets. Deployment Plan lists the plans that have this step. Choose it and select Save; without such a plan, the page asks you to create one.

chapters.title: Export to a target
chapters.subtitle: File Download, one item or several

steps.text: Once the plan is chosen, the Actions menu offers Export to Deployment Target. Let's choose it for Apple Harvest Schedule.

The Available Targets dialog lists each target with a description. File Download downloads a plan locally, and a configured remote instance appears here too. A separate video covers remote deployment.
Let's select File Download. The site runs the plan with this item, and the browser saves a zip deployment package.
For several items, select two or more checkboxes, open Actions, and choose Export to deployment target.
Confirm with Ok, and select File Download. The package holds every selected item.
Download as JSON saves one item, Add to Deployment Plan keeps it in a plan, and Export to Deployment Target sends items once. Thanks for watching.
